title: Tough as Faces
description: Replaces the default sphere in Tough as Nails with a player face!
body:
Tough as Faces!

A resource pack that replaces [Tough as Nails'](https://modrinth.com/mod/tough-as-nails) default sphere with a minecraft player face!

Likely incompatible with other resource packs that apply changes to tough as nails' hud.

Just made to have some variety, and I wanted to make a resource pack for the first time.

Should work with a majority of TaN updates
